messages:
Renee (CSM): Hi team 1 0 kickoff for Celerity. Aim: working integration + internal demo by day 9. Quick sync at 2pm PT?

Omar (Solutions Eng): Ill bring routing, rate limits, and a perf checklist. Need their peak concurrency and sample payloads.

Aditi (Customer): We expect ~600 req/day ramping to 2r/s. Ill upload payload examples and auth requirements this afternoon.

Jules (Enablement): I can run a 30m enablement: console + API quickstart, alerts overview. Proposed Fri 11am PT.

Aditi (Customer): Fri 11am PT works. Also require SCIM docs and SIEM audit forwarding.

Renee (CSM): Initial success criteria (day 9):
1) Integration sending >=4k tokens test traffic
2) p95 latency <550ms
3) Internal demo + acceptance notes. Owners: Integration=Aditi/Omar, Observability=Jules, Security=Renee.

Omar (Solutions Eng): Suggest hosted with autoscale + prefix KV caching. Ill post runtime recommendations after the sync.

onboard-bot: Reminder 1 please complete pre-onboard form https://forms.redwood.ai/celerity (due Thu 5pm PT)

Jules (Enablement): Invite sent + quickstart attached. Ill include Splunk forwarding steps and SCIM checklist.

Aditi (Customer): Uploaded payloads and schema. Thanks all.

Omar (Solutions Eng): Config snippet Im proposing:
```
model: rw-6b
batching: enabled
kv_cache: prefix
latency_target_ms: 550
monitoring: prom/p95, audit=forward
```

Renee (CSM): Great. Ill create Trello cards and schedule a day-3 check-in. :thumbsup:
